### WebGLRenderer~InfoMemory

Source: https://threejs.org/docs/pages/WebGLRenderer.html

The InfoMemory type definition for WebGLRenderer, listing properties that describe memory usage.

```APIDOC
## WebGLRenderer~InfoMemory

### Description
WebGLRenderer Info Memory. Provides information about allocated objects.

### Properties
- **geometries** (number) - The number of active geometries.
- **textures** (number) - The number of active textures.
```

### WebGLRenderer > .getDrawingBufferSize( target : Vector2 ) : Vector2

Source: https://threejs.org/docs/pages/WebGLRenderer.html

Returns the drawing buffer size in physical pixels. This method honors the pixel ratio.

**target**

The method writes the result in this target object.

**Returns:** The drawing buffer size.

--------------------------------
